title: "Could not find a connection ... not part of the same tree" in ROS 2 tf2: four causes and the fix for each, measured
excerpt: What tf2's "Tf has two or more unconnected trees" means and the four setups that caused it in rclpy and tf2_echo on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical, with the fix for each, why a timeout only delays it, why except LookupException misses it, and how two parents give wrong values instead.
